# Smile Town Dentistry

> A comprehensive pediatric dental practice in North Delta, Surrey, and Delta specializing in children's dentistry, orthodontics, and specialized care for kids with special needs.

Smile Town Dentistry is a family-focused pediatric dental practice led by Dr. Diya Chadha and Dr. Sukrit Grewal, offering comprehensive services from infant care through adolescence, including general dentistry, sedation options, orthodontics with Invisalign First, and specialized treatment for children with special needs. The practice emphasizes a kid-friendly environment and accepts the Canadian Dental Care Plan.

- [Infant Dentists Surrey | SmileTown Dentistry, North Delta](https://www.smiletownnorthdelta.com/site/baby-care-dentist-north-delta): Infant and baby dental care services starting with primary tooth eruption
- [Teens Dentists | Smile Town Dentistry, Surrey](https://www.smiletownnorthdelta.com/site/teen-dentist-north-delta): Adolescent dental care including braces and wisdom teeth management
- [Special Needs Children's Dentists In Surrey & Delta](https://www.smiletownnorthdelta.com/site/children-special-needs-dentist): Specialized dental care for children with special needs and autism/ADHD
- [Sedation Options | SmileTown Dentistry, Surrey](https://www.smiletownnorthdelta.com/site/sedation-children-dentist): Pediatric sedation options for anxious or special needs children at SmileTown

- [Invisalign First Orthodontics | Burnaby Children's Dentist](https://www.smiletownnorthdelta.com/site/invisalign-first-children-delta): Invisalign First clear aligners for children's teeth straightening at SmileTown
- [Surrey Orthodontics | Smile Town Dentistry, North Delta](https://www.smiletownnorthdelta.com/site/children-orthodontist-delta): Interceptive orthodontics for early detection and correction of dental issues
